password_tooltip: Password of the subscriber in the adapter settings. Stored in the vis project: everybody who can open the project can read it
wss_url_tooltip: Empty: the address of the adapter instance (info.wssUrl)
number_tooltip: Number called by the call button, e.g. the door intercom
use_camera_tooltip: Off: the camera is never opened, the picture of the other party is still shown
camera_url_tooltip: Snapshot or MJPEG URL, shown during calls when the other party sends no video
camera_oid_tooltip: State with a picture URL or a data URL (e.g. of the cameras adapter). Overrides the camera URL
camera_refresh_tooltip: 0 for an MJPEG stream, otherwise the snapshot is reloaded in this interval
camera_always: Show the camera also without a call
action_label_tooltip: Button during a call, e.g. "Open door". Empty: no button
click_sound: Click into the page to enable the ring tone
insecure: Microphone and camera need HTTPS: open vis via https:// (web adapter with a certificate)
no_config: Enter extension and password in the widget settings
no_wss: Address of Asterisk unknown: is the adapter instance running?
cert_hint: No connection? The browser must trust the certificate of Asterisk once:
editor_preview: editor preview, connects only in the runtime
title: Title
